header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: I seek Your protection from the evil of what I have done; I acknowledge the blessings You have showered upon me, and I also acknowledge my sins. So forgive me! For none can forgive sins except You”. If a person recites these words with firm conviction at any time during the day and dies before that evening, he will be one of the people of Jannah. Likewise, if a person says these words at any time in the evening and dies before Fajr, he will be one of the people of Jannah”, Hazrat Shaddad ibn Aws (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ (فَسُبْحنَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَّحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ۞) إِلَي (وَكَذلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ۞). (الروم :١٩-١٧) أَدْرَكَ مَا فَاتَهُ فِي يَوْمِهِ ذلِكَ وَمَنْ قَالَهُنَّ حِينَ يُمْسِي أَدْرَكَ مَافَاتَهُ فِي لَيْلَتِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب مَايَقُولُ اذا اَصْبَحَ رقم:٥٠٧٦
blocks.tamil_translation: .”(In Surah Ar-Rum) (فَسُبْحنَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَّحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ) Glorify and praise Allah Ta'ala when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning. To Him belongs all praise in the heavens and the earth! And in the late afternoon and at midday (declare the purity of Allah Ta'ala). He brings forth the living from the dead. He brings forth the dead from the living. And He gives life (fertility) to the earth after its death (dryness). Likewise you will be brought forth (from the graves on the Day of Qiyamah)” (Ar-Rum: 30:17,18,19) — whoever recites up to this ayah in the morning will obtain the (reward of the deeds) missed during that day
